facts.program: PGW EnergySense roof insulation and air sealing
facts.claim: Gas-heated PGW residential customers, retrofits only, BPI-certified contractor, pre and post photos. Finished >=R-49 with air sealing $0.65/sq ft (Affordable $0.95); without $0.60 ($0.90). >=R-38 with air sealing $0.35 ($0.50); without $0.30 ($0.40). Affordable tier: CRP, Hardship Funds or LIHEAP to PGW in last year. Participating contractors can give instant rebates; using one not required. First-come, subject to funds; check processing currently delayed.
facts.eligibility: PGW customers heating with natural gas

facts.claim: Free weatherization for households at or below 200% of federal poverty level (priority elderly, disabled, children, high energy users): blower-door air sealing, attic/wall/basement/crawlspace insulation, heating repair or replacement, health and safety. Average spend $8,547 per household.

facts.program: Philadelphia Energy Authority Built to Last
facts.claim: Coordinates home repair, health and energy upgrade programs for underserved Philadelphia homeowners in one process; no dollar amount published. Phone 215-686-4483.
30% credit up to $1,200 a year for improvements placed in service through December 31, 2025. Nothing for 2026 installs.
